question: Should OpenClaw adopt this plugin-facing, durable core AI-safety event taxonomy now, and if so what minimal event, retention, and observer contract should be stable?
rationale: The patch changes plugin SDK/manifest contracts, persistent shared-state ownership, Gateway protocol, exporters, and operator UI; code review cannot safely choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow core contract
options.body: Sponsor a documented minimal taxonomy and observer/emitter policy, then require the contributor to repair session attribution and prove the final Gateway-to-exporter path.

options.title: Keep safety integrations plugin-owned
options.body: Reject or trim the new core/plugin SDK and durable UI surface, retaining only any narrowly justified generic seam after an owner design review.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause the implementation until maintainers define the intended operator safety-observability roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a documented minimal taxonomy and observer/emitter policy, then require the contributor to repair session attribution and prove the final Gateway-to-exporter path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the underlying proposal and can provide design context, while a repository owner must make the final product decision.
